name: @autodev/pipeline-signals
description: AutoDev pipeline completion hooks: authoritative session-end signals and structural pre-checks via agent_end and before_agent_finalize

scripts.deploy: npm run build && DEST="${OPENCLAW_ROOT:-$HOME/.openclaw}/extensions/autodev-pipeline-signals/dist/index.js" && if [ -f "$DEST" ]; then cp dist/index.js "$DEST" && echo "[deploy] copied dist/index.js → $DEST" && echo "[deploy] next: systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway"; else echo "[deploy] extension not installed at $DEST — run install.sh, or first-time: openclaw plugins install '$(pwd)'"; fi
